title: Pulse
content: This is going to be really out there but I think someone else was in my dream…I will explain as much as I can…. So the other person and “pulse”…. Does that mean anything to anyone? My dream is fading some but I woke up mumbling about my dream early this morning… and then fell back asleep into the same dream. But it was different than a normal dream. I can’t explain most of what happened although I can say with confidence there was a compound with people that were separated by age groups, we were trapped there, buildings set up in a grid, two rows of buildings, each building more than one story but I don’t remember how many stories. I know the enemy is PULSE. And I never saw one but they were everywhere and they knew everything. They knew what each other knew instantly too, this is where I would say hive mind, but it was more like invisible sentient mycelium than a hive. Like…. quantum entanglement on a mass scale? I tried escaping over and over but couldn’t. And the closest I got to getting out was through tunneling! Tunneling through the dirt. Like a freaking mole, digging tunnels-but only so far and then I’m lit up (can’t explain) and then I’m back at the barracks. Then I am exploring the other buildings, and this is where the other person comes in to my story. I’m in a different building-not one I’m assigned to but one assigned to another group. And I’m trying not to get caught while I’m walking through this building and all of a sudden something hits my head. I looked up and there was a hole in the ceiling and someone was up there, looking down at me. I panicked, in my dream the other person was not like the other dream people, I’m not sure how I knew but I just knew. Also, they had a yellow scarf or maybe a collar on but I couldn’t tell you now if it was a male or female with 100% certainty, but I do think it was a man. I thought at that moment that they were trying to hurt me, because I was already afraid in the dream and they hit me in the head with something so I just freaked out, I can’t renege exactly what I did, I think I woke up not long after. Except- now I think maybe they were just trying to get my attention. And for some reason I have this really strong feeling that it WAS someone else for real and they were like, lucid dreaming, or they were projected somehow into this very specific dreamscape. And this dreamscape was not normal. I wish I had better words but I can’t think of any right this minute. I don’t usually put much thought into my dreams because I often have really weird dreams, but every once in awhile I just know that it is NOT just a dream, it’s something else. Idk what. But I woke up thinking PULSE and it won’t get out of my head. Pulse. It’s got to mean something, or I’m under entirely too much stress….. lol
